title.justification: The paper's focus is on enhancing the robustness of deep networks through the introduction of equivariance in perception tasks.
title.quote: In this paper, we introduce a framework that uses the dense intrinsic constraints in natural images to robustify inference. By introducing constraints at inference time, we can shift the burden of robustness from training to testing...

extractions.description: This paper addresses the issue of improving adversarial robustness in deep networks for computer vision by utilizing equivariance. The authors propose a method to robustify inference by introducing dense constraints at inference time instead of during training. The concept of equivariance is used to dynamically adjust models to individual images' unique characteristics at test time, without the requirement to retrain. Empirical results show enhanced robustness across various datasets and tasks, such as image recognition, semantic segmentation, and instance segmentation.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the paper is focused on improving robustness in computer vision tasks, it does not address climate or ecological sustainability directly. The central theme is enhancing model robustness against adversarial attacks in general computer vision applications.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: The method obtains improved adversarial robustness on four datasets (ImageNet, Cityscapes, PASCAL VOC, and MS-COCO) on image recognition, semantic segmentation, and instance segmentation tasks.

primary_category.quote: However, the robustness against a large number of adversarial cases remains a prerequisite necessary to deploy models in real-world applications, such as in medical imaging, healthcare, and robotics.
